name: occamy-1.0
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA plus gated linear attention: 30 of 40 layers are linear_attention and 10 are full_attention, one every fourth layer
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 35.107 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-08-13. RECORDED 2026-10-25 from the card's own HTML benchmark table, where its column is first and the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B starting checkpoint is the second column of the same table. Wins on 10 of the rows transcribed: Terminal-Bench 2.1 59.00 vs 49.50, Claw-Eval average 82.20 vs 69.50, Claw-Eval Pass^3 71.40 vs 54.80, WildClawBench 49.16 vs 40.40, CommerceAgentBench 37.38 vs 19.60, OfficeQA Pro 48.10 vs 39.10, tau^3-Banking 37.10 vs 11.90, AutomationBench Pass^1 27.60 vs 7.50, BFCL v4 65.40 vs 63.19, IFEval 91.53 vs 86.90. LOSES on VitaBench (41.75 vs 34.25 is a win, but 46.00 for BigBang beats it) and sits below larger models on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (Ornith-1.5 67.80, GPT-5.6 Sol 88.80). No harness is printed for either the card column or the base column, and the card asterisks only the third-party official numbers, so these base-vs-tuned rows are nominally like-for-like but unverifiable. Not a low-VRAM target: 35B total / 3B active with a vision tower kept in the checkpoint; bf16 weights are 70.22 GB per the card's file table, so it needs expert offload. The card also ships 17 GGUF variants and MLX 3-8 bit cuts, all still marked 'Mac Metal acceptance pending'.
